title: 第十七章 夜梦
content_zh: 孙元将方彻送回家，跟方浅意交代了一下之后，就离开了。徒儿天资聪颖，缺少的便是积累，必须去寻找一些天材地宝了。教主他们也忒小气，居然没有留下点灵药灵丹啥的给我徒弟。方浅意对于儿子救回来的这个昏迷的姑娘很是感兴趣，安排在厢房，吩咐秋雪和冬梅好好伺候。然后自己还是放心不下，拿了丹药，亲自去为夜梦服下，并推血过宫化开药力。吩咐冬梅去请郎中。自己亲手拿了一块雪白的毛巾给夜梦擦拭。忍不住笑了起来：“我儿子眼光还是不错，这丫头还真是个大美人。”眼珠一转，偷偷看看左右没人，喃喃自语：“我给这丫头检查一下伤哪里了，严重不。”于是从上到下，检查了一遍，头，脸，脖子，肩膀，胸，小腹，屁股，大腿……笑的合不拢嘴：“不错不错，胸不小，屁股很饱满，还是处子，嗯嗯……眼光不错，眼光不错。”突然咳嗽一声，正色喃喃道：“这孩子，伤得不轻啊……”门口人影出现，却是秋雪端着一碗药过来了：“小姐，药熬好了。”“哦哦……”方浅意咳嗽一声：“小心伺候。”“是。”方浅意转身离开。两人都没注意，床上的夜梦脸色稍稍有些发红。而精致的小耳朵后面，已经是通红了。夜梦到了晚上，才悠悠醒来。过了一夜，稍稍恢复一些元气，强撑着道谢，三天后，才终于有点行动的力量，恢复的也更快了起来。方彻一直在练功。他现在需要练的功法很多，每一天，都基本是没有任何闲暇时间。无量真经的刀枪剑戟，他都在练习。而前世的自己的所有技能，他只是挑选了一些来练，其他的，都放弃了。一来，前世起点太低，功法招式，有一些上不得台面；二来便是，前世自己到了一定地步之后，得到的机缘和功法等，都具备太强的代表性。用出来，若是被当年的老对手和老兄弟看到，难免会有想法。所以他尽量谨慎。能不用，便不用。“若是有一天，哪怕你们将我当做一心教妖人击毙，我也毫无怨言。”心中是这么想，真到了事到临头，也会这么做。但是方彻自然不想真的到那一地步。所以他现在修炼起来，拼命程度乃是任何人看到，都是瞠目结舌的。这不像是练功，而是直接就是将自己当做一块生铁来锻造了。尤其是无量真经的刀枪剑戟，方彻更加是细心揣摩。一点一滴的狠狠吃透。这四门功法，简直是包罗万象。全部都是基础招式。但却是五花八门。比如在‘剑’的类目中，只是一个拔剑，就分了很多种。拔剑式，左腰拔剑式，右腰拔剑式，手持拔剑式，脱鞘拔剑式，飞鞘拔剑式，左负剑拔剑式，右……方彻都忍不住倒抽一口气。太全面了。至于，刺剑式，削剑式，撩剑式，劈剑式，点剑式；崩剑式，截剑式，抹剑式，提剑式……每一式，都要比拔剑式多出几十倍。至于刀，枪，戟；都是一样。没有具体招，只有各种式。但是方彻却知道，这才是真正的大家之作！这些熟练了之后，任何刀剑招，不过是随手拈来。甚至，不需要招式。因为你已经掌握了任何情况下攻击的方法。“对于这四种兵器的了解，这里面的记载，已经是登峰造极了吧。”这些都熟稔于心，差的依然是熟练度。但是这些全部了解之后，对于自己现在学的孙元的各种功法，各种刀法等，包括孙元仗以成名的‘飞天刀法’，对于方彻来说，都是水到渠成一般。甚至，连印神宫的血灵七式，都是可以触类旁通。修炼起来，并不费事。然后便是将重点放在冰澈灵台，和幻骨易形上面。话说回来，同时修炼这么多功夫，哪怕方彻再天才好几倍，也绝对做不到兼顾。所以，凌晨起来，修炼刀枪剑戟基础式，两个时辰。配以灵兽肉和药膳吃早饭。然后是飞天刀法，血灵七式，两个时辰。午饭。然后是飞天刀法，血灵七式，两個时辰。晚饭。然后是幻骨易形，冰澈灵台，两个时辰。夜宵。然后开着无量真经睡觉。中间配合以各种丹药。以及，可以收到手的各种修炼资源。又是七天过去。方彻已经将自己的修为，推到了武士第六层。半月时间，前进两重，虽然是小阶位，但这样的进度，已经足够惊世骇俗。但方彻依然没有半点满足，相反，心里依然是危机重重，对于能否得到‘东南道第一名’这个目标，没有半点把握。因为他知道，大家族中，不缺天才。而那些天才，自从出生就有高手以真元疏通经脉，人家的功法，也是一等一的好功法；还有就是，人家的修炼辅助材料，绝对不是自己现在能比的。自己真正能依靠的，可以弯道超车的，其实就只有无量真经和刀枪剑戟。以及……自己现在这种旷古绝今的资质！努力这两个字，更是自己最重要的致胜法宝！所以他是真正的一点都不敢放松。……这一天，方彻在练功的时候，感觉有人窥探，转头一看，只见在厢房门口，一个娇弱的窈窕身姿，正扶着门框，一步一挪的走出来。
content_en: Sun Yuan sent Fang Che home, explained to Fang Qianyi, and left.My disciple is very talented, but what he lacks is accumulation. He must look for some natural and earthly treasures.The leader and others were so stingy that they didn't leave any elixir or elixir for my disciple.Fang Qianyi was very interested in the unconscious girl who was rescued by her son. She arranged her in the side room and told Qiuxue and Dongmei to take good care of her.Then he still felt uneasy, so he took the elixir, drank it for Ye Meng himself, and pushed the blood through the uterus to dissolve the medicine.Instruct Dongmei to invite the doctor.He personally took a snow-white towel and wiped it with Ye Meng.He couldn't help but laugh: "My son has good eyesight. This girl is really a beauty." He rolled his eyes, secretly looked around to see if there was no one around, and murmured to himself: "Let me check where the girl's injuries are. Is it serious?" So he checked from top to bottom, head, face, neck, shoulders, chest, lower abdomen, butt, thighs... He smiled from ear to ear: "Not bad, not bad.Her breasts are not small, her butt is full, and she is still a virgin.She has good eyesight and good eyesight." She suddenly coughed and murmured seriously: "This child is seriously injured..." A figure appeared at the door, but it was Qiu Xue who came over with a bowl of medicine: "Miss, the medicine is ready." "Oh..." Fang Qianyi coughed: "Be careful." "Yes" Fang Qianyi turned around and left.Neither of them noticed that Ye Meng's face turned slightly red on the bed.And behind the delicate little ears, it was already red.It was only at night that I woke up from my dream.After a night, I regained some strength, and I forced myself to say thank you. Three days later, I finally had the strength to act, and my recovery became faster.Fang Che has been practicing.He needs to practice a lot of skills now, and he basically doesn't have any free time every day.He was practicing the swords, spears, swords and halberds of the Infinite Scriptures.Of all the skills he had in his previous life, he only picked some to practice and gave up on the others.Firstly, the starting point in the previous life was too low, and some of the techniques and moves were not good enough; secondly, after reaching a certain level in the previous life, the opportunities and techniques obtained were too representative.If you use it, your old rivals and brothers will inevitably have ideas if you see it.So he tried to be cautious.If you can't use it, don't use it."If one day, even if you kill me as a single-minded cultivator, I will have no complaints." I thought so in my heart, and I would do the same thing when the time comes.But Fang Che naturally didn't want to really get to that point.So now that he is cultivating, he works so hard that anyone who sees him will be stunned.This is not like practicing martial arts, but just forging oneself like a piece of pig iron.In particular, Fang Che studied the swords, guns, swords and halberds of the Infinite Scriptures even more carefully.Take it all in bit by bit.These four techniques are simply all-encompassing.All are basic moves.But they are diverse.For example, in the category of ‘sword’, just drawing a sword can be divided into many types.Drawing the sword from the left waist, drawing the sword from the right waist, holding the sword in hand, drawing the sword without the sheath, drawing the sword with the flying scabbard, drawing the sword with the sword on the left, right... Fang Che couldn't help but gasp.Too comprehensive.As for the thrusting sword style, the sword sharpening style, the sword lifting style, the sword splitting style, the sword pointing style; the sword breaking style, the sword cutting style, the sword wiping style, the sword lifting style... each style is dozens of times more powerful than the sword drawing style.As for swords, spears, and halberds, they are all the same.There are no specific moves, just various styles.But Fang Che knew that this was truly everyone’s work!Once you are proficient in these, any sword moves are just random.Even, no moves are needed.Because you already know how to attack in any situation."My understanding of these four weapons and the records here must be at the pinnacle." I am familiar with these, but the only difference is my proficiency.But after understanding all of this, Fang Che found it easy to learn Sun Yuan's various exercises and sword techniques, including the "Flying Sword Technique" that Sun Yuan became famous for.Even the Seven Blood Spirit Styles of the Yin Shen Palace can be understood by analogy.It is not troublesome to practice.Then focus on the Ice Clear Spirit Platform and the Phantom Bone Transformation.Having said that, if Fang Che is practicing so many skills at the same time, even if Fang Che is several times more talented, he will never be able to do it all.So, I got up early in the morning and practiced the basic postures of sword, spear, sword and halberd for two hours.Have breakfast with spirit animal meat and medicinal food.Then came the Feitian Sword Technique, the Seven Blood Spirit Styles, which lasted two hours.lunch.Then came the Feitian Sword Technique, the Seven Blood Spirit Styles, which lasted two hours.dinner.Then came the Phantom Bone Transformation and Ice Clear Spirit Platform, which lasted two hours.night snack.Then sleep with the Infinite Sutra on.Various elixirs are mixed in the middle.And, you can receive various cultivation resources.Another seven days passed.Fang Che has pushed his cultivation to the sixth level of warrior.In half a month, he has advanced two levels. Although it is a small level, this progress is enough to shock the world.But Fang Che was still not satisfied at all. On the contrary, he was still filled with crises and was not sure whether he could achieve the goal of being ranked first in the Southeast Road.Because he knows that there is no shortage of geniuses in the big family.As for those geniuses, they have mastered using true energy to clear their meridians since they were born, and their techniques are also top-notch. Also, their cultivation auxiliary materials are definitely not what I can compare to now.The only things that he can really rely on and can overtake in corners are the Wuliang Sutra and swords, guns, swords and halberds.And...my current unparalleled qualifications!The two words "hard work" are my most important magic weapon to win!So he really didn't dare to relax at all....On this day, while Fang Che was practicing, he felt someone was spying on him. He turned around and saw a delicate and graceful figure at the door of the wing, holding on to the door frame and walking out step by step.
